set.body:
Acceptance (all required):
- Every moved public concept has one provider owner, its real consumers, a replacement/deletion entry and a compatibility decision.
- Provenance packaging, shared neuroimaging frame declarations and strict/raw mesh admission are decided; the proposed graph is acyclic.
- Existing tests and runnable workflow baselines are mapped to owners; target composition specimens are defined with current gaps recorded. No extended audit or new framework is required.

Close after its child implementation tasks and their evidence satisfy these criteria. Shared requirements: eco-unification; architecture: docs/plans/ecosystem-unification.md.
set.title: U0 milestone: Freeze ownership and compatibility decisions
